Class ViewLessonEditor

java.lang.Object
guiLessonEditor.ViewLessonEditor
public class ViewLessonEditor extends Object

Title: ViewLessonEditor Class.

Description: The Java/FX-based lesson editor page, used both to record a new lesson (CS-1) and to change an existing one (CS-7). One page serves both purposes because the fields, their limits, and their checks are identical; two copies of the same form would be two places for the rules to drift apart, which is exactly what CS-7 says must not happen.

Each field has its name above it and a live count of characters used beside the name, so the contributor can see the limit before they reach it (CS-11) instead of discovering it only when Save refuses the lesson. The contributor is shown as text, not as a field, because it is always the logged in account (CS-9).

As in every supplied View, this class is a singleton. The constructor builds the widgets once; displayLessonEditor(Stage, User, LessonsLearned) fills them in for a new or an existing lesson.

  • Method Details

    • displayLessonEditor

      public static void displayLessonEditor(javafx.stage.Stage ps, entityClasses.User user, entityClasses.LessonsLearned lesson)

      Method: displayLessonEditor(Stage ps, User user, LessonsLearned lesson)

      Description: The single entry point from outside this package that displays the lesson editor. With a null lesson the form is empty and Save creates a new lesson (CS-1). With a lesson, the form shows its current values (CS-7: the contributor edits the real current text rather than retyping it, and a field left alone stays as it was).

      Parameters:
      ps - the JavaFX Stage to be used for this GUI and its methods
      user - the User for this GUI and its methods
      lesson - the lesson to edit, or null to record a new one
